summary: Russian forces captured Novovodyanoye in Donetsk region and Ulanovo in Sumy region while launching massive drone waves including Geran-5 missiles and jet-powered Shaheds across northern and central Ukraine. Ukrainian forces claim 10,660 Russian casualties in a week on the Lyman front but face "dronophobia" among troops and inability to deploy interceptor drones at scale. Russian strikes hit Ukrainian drone production facilities, Izmail port, and Odesa logistics centers, while a Ukrainian attack derailed rail wagons in Bryansk region.
key_points: Russian "Center" group liberated Novovodyanoye in DPR per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/397687)
Russian "North" group established control over Ulanovo in Sumy region per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/397686)
Ukrainian AFU claimed 10,660 Russian killed/wounded in a week on Lyman direction during Operation Vivaldi. (Source: @UkraineNow/84342)
Massive Russian drone attack: 7 Geran-5 rockets from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv, plus multiple jet-powered Shaheds across northern and central Ukraine. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75826)
Russian missile strikes damaged Ukrainian drone manufacturer Pegasus Arms facilities twice, forcing indefinite suspension of operations. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557)
Russian forces struck ship repair enterprise in Izmail port and border guard deployment point, hitting two dry cargo ships with military cargo. (Source: @tass_agency/397656)
Ukrainian attack derailed 18 empty half-wagons in Unecha district, Bryansk region per Russian authorities. (Source: @tass_agency/397679)
Budanov stated AFU cannot mass-deploy interceptor drones soon as prototypes only in testing. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33551)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces seized Novovodyanoye in Donetsk region and Ulanovo in Sumy region, marking tactical gains on two fronts. Simultaneously, Russia launched a coordinated drone offensive with at least seven Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv toward Kyiv and numerous jet-powered Shaheds targeting Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, Chernihiv, and Kyiv regions. Ukraine claims heavy Russian losses on the Lyman front but acknowledges critical gaps in interceptor drone capacity and rising psychological strain from persistent drone threats.

points: Ukrainian forces claim 10,660 Russian personnel killed and wounded over the past week on the Lyman direction in Donetsk region during Operation Vivaldi, according to President Zelensky. (Source: @UkraineNow/84342)

Ukrainian drone manufacturer Pegasus Arms suspended operations indefinitely after Russian missile strikes damaged its production facility on September 2 and a relocation site on September 23–24. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33557)
GUR chief Budanov stated the AFU will not be able to deploy interceptor drones on a mass scale anytime soon, as prototypes are currently only being tested. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33551)
Le Monde reports "dronophobia" spreading among AFU troops, a nervous condition stemming from fear of drones causing helplessness despite no physical injuries. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33552)

Sociological group "Rating" director Alexei Antipovich says Ukrainian mood is becoming apathetic, with Kiev residents showing the worst psychological state compared to Kharkiv, Dnipro, and Odesa. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33563)
Prime Minister Koretsky announced a planned 1% VAT increase factored into the state budget, citing no other revenue sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33558)

Achilles brigade (Unmanned Systems Forces) is recruiting a firmware engineer for rear workshop duties including UAV diagnostics, receiver/transmitter flashing, and flight controller calibration, offering 50,000 UAH. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23863)
Russian "Center" grouping liberated Novovodyanoye in the DPR, per Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/397687)
Russian "North" grouping established control over Ulanovo in Sumy region, per Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/397686)

Russian forces launched at least seven Geran-5 missiles from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, with additional Geran-5s targeting Rivne, Zdolbuniv, Khmelnytskyi, and Chernihiv regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75826)

Russian jet-powered Shahed drones operated from multiple launch points: Bryansk, Chernihiv, Sumy, Cherkasy, Vinnytsia, and Donetsk regions, targeting Kyiv, Chernihiv, Rivne, Khmelnytskyi, and Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75823)

Russian air defense claimed interception of 254 Ukrainian fixed-wing UAVs over Russian regions, including 21 over Kaluga region and approximately 20 over Voronezh and six municipalities. (Source: @tass_agency/397674)

Russian strikes hit a ship repair enterprise in Izmail port, a permanent deployment point of the Ukrainian State Border Guard Service, and two dry cargo ships carrying military cargo for the AFU. (Source: @tass_agency/397656)
Russian forces struck the "Nova Poshta" logistics center in Odesa storing military cargo, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/397655)
Russian "Center" group captured Novovodyanoye in Donetsk region, advancing in the eastern sector. (Source: @tass_agency/397687)
DeepState map update indicates enemy forces advanced near Bilytske in Donetsk region. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23864)
Ukrainian forces claim significant results on the Lyman direction in Donetsk region as part of Operation Vivaldi, reporting 10,660 Russian casualties in a week. (Source: @UkraineNow/84342)
Russian jet-powered UAVs detected over Kamianskyi district of Dnipropetrovsk region moving northward. (Source: @kpszsu/80907)
Russian drone launched from Donetsk region targeted Pavlohrad district in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75823)
Russian "North" group seized Ulanovo in Sumy region, per Russian MoD. (Source: @tass_agency/397686)

Multiple jet-powered UAVs tracked in Chernihiv region: near Ripky (moving southwest), Honcharivske, Mykhailo-Kotsiubynske, Kozelets, and Horodnia areas, originating from Bryansk and northern directions. (Source: @kpszsu/80896, @kpszsu/80910, @kpszsu/80942, @kpszsu/80912, @eRadarrua/117884)
Jet-powered UAVs detected in Sumy region near Kroleveets and Khutir Mykhailivskyi from the northeast. (Source: @kpszsu/80920, @kpszsu/80913)
Ukrainian attack derailed 18 empty half-wagons in Unecha district, Bryansk region, per acting governor. (Source: @tass_agency/397679)
Geran-5 missile launched from Bryansk region targeted Chernihiv region (Chernihiv district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75823)
